Think of them as Americans.|Joan's last words to [[Steph Harper]]}} '''Joan''' is a character in the [[Fallout TV series season 2|second season]] of the [[Fallout (TV series)|''Fallout'' TV series]]. ==Background== Joan is a Canadian citizen who was interned at the [[Uranium City Internment Camp]], along with her daughter [[Steph Harper|Steph]], by the occupying [[United States Armed Forces]] during the [[United States annexation of Canada]]. She has a hatred of Americans as a result, a mindset she imparts on her daughter. ==''Fallout'' TV series== ===[[The Handoff]]=== At some point in the 2070s, Joan and her daughter Steph escape from the Uranium City Internment Camp. They and other Canadian escapees are hunted by the U.S. military as they do so. The two of them are soon cornered by a [[Vertibird (TV series)|Vertibird]] and a [[United States Marine Corps|U.S. Marine]] who threatens to shoot them if they do not return to the camp. A [[Canadian rebel|suicide bomber]] kills the Marine, although Joan is mortally wounded. Despite Steph's attempts to get her mother to come with her, Joan realizes she is too badly wounded and gives Steph instructions on how to survive. She tells Steph to cross the border into the [[United States of America|United States]] and reach as high of a position as she can in American society to survive the coming "flood." She also tells Steph to forget her Catholic upbringing and instead kill whoever she needs to in order to survive, and not to see the people in the United States as human beings, but just as "Americans." ==Appearances== Joan appears only {{In|FOTV}}. {{FOTV appearances|15=207}} ==Behind the scenes== Joan uses some expressions that are indicative of [[wikipedia:Newfoundland English|Newfoundland English]], including the slang "Lord thundering Jesus" (subtitled as "Lord tunderin' Jaysus" to match her pronunciation) and "My love" to refer to Steph. Joan's actress, [[Natasha Henstridge]], is native to [[wikipedia:Newfoundland and Labrador|Newfoundland]]. ==Gallery== FoTV Joan closeup.png {{Navbox characters FOTV}} [[Category:Fallout TV series human characters]] [[ru:Джоан]]
